topic: Defining Constructors Outside the Class Body
explanation: While constructors can be defined inline within the class definition, defining them outside the class body offers several advantages, particularly when dealing with complex initialization logic or when you need to separate the interface (class declaration) from the implementation (function definitions).  This improves code readability and maintainability, especially in larger projects.  It also allows for more sophisticated initialization strategies, such as delegating to other constructors.
